findings.title: Pin the reviewed media context across asynchronous byte verification
findings.trigger: An anchor/take command starts under current contextA, awaits readAssetVerified, and meanwhile the selected story/plan/animatic or exact current approval set changes to compatible contextB. The candidate identity/hash and media bytes remain unchanged.
findings.actual: validateMediaProvenance only tests productionSubmissionEligibilityFingerprint for nonnull at each read, discarding its value. The commit compares target hash and asset ID/checksum/vaultRef but no initial context fingerprint, so contextB can still append this command decision.
findings.expected: Reject the original command with STALE_REVISION and append no decision when relevant initial context changes during await. A fresh retry may approve the same candidate if the successor context is currently compatible.
findings.requiredChange: Preserve the initial media eligibility fingerprint and compare with the transaction reread, alongside relevant verified asset metadata; do not use project saveVersion or require prior manual candidate selection.
findings.requiredEvidence: One bounded async verification/drift case showing no write for the original command and current-compatible fresh retry. Existing six-case suite and typecheck remain the verification scope.
findings.basis: Original approval.transaction says drift/error returns no writes; root explicitly confirmed exact relevant initial context must be frozen across await and current compatible successor is accepted only on fresh retry.
findings.proofType: Source inspection; no new test/probe or source edits performed by reviewer.

reviewedBehavior: Frozen per-kind checklist dimensions and strict uniqueness/exact set checks are present. Approved outcomes require every mandatory item passed through existing DTOs.

Deterministic ID uses the frozen schemaVersion/operation/project/idempotency tuple. Exact historical replay checks actor, target/hash, decision, checklist order/strings, notes and advisory order/strings byte-for-byte before fresh target validation.

Current selected revision/project ownership checks are present. Anchor/take candidates may be reviewed before manual selection; shared helper checks compatible originating shots, current canon/story/plan/animatic and current actual approval pins.

Media validation checks completed job/result target, result asset membership, exact durable receipt; take validates anchor approval/hash pins, measured asset/take frame equality and muted provider audio policy.
Canon/audio media require known rights and checksum-verifiable bytes. Provider rights accepted; unknown and legacy_unreviewed denied. Current audio story/mix and cue assets are resolved.
Null anchor vision maps to unavailable and requires nonblank vision_unavailable acknowledgement. Fresh final decisions return QC_BLOCKED without writes.
Decision now sampled inside synchronous transaction and must exceed maximum existing target time; no synthetic future timestamp. Exact replay after an async concurrent append is handled.

Route is strict same-origin/body guarded, bounded64KiB and no-store201/200. Actor is trusted server local creator; default vault reader uses configured data directory and maps failures to sanitized MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE.
No other material finding identified within the five-file scope. Current source leaves the existing WAL retry/timing behavior unchanged.
evidenceInterpretation: Read saved GREEN6tests, typecheck without diagnostics, and RED3executed failures against stubs. RED is bootstrap behavior, not a counterfactual proof for the current async-context gap. Argv and hashes match report.
limitations: Existing six tests do not exercise async selected-context drift, every canon/audio/take target, historical replay after reopen, or backward time; source branches reviewed without additional coverage.
Worker typecheck evidence hash verified; independent typecheck not repeated.
No broad suite, build, paid/authenticated calls, credentials or provider evidence inspected.
Integration acceptance withheld until the bounded material finding is fixed and exact follow-up SHA reviewed.
